transforms.name: request-total
transforms.effect: With at least one token bucket, totalTokens is the sum and meterTokens is fresh input plus output. Cost-only events omit the token total.

transforms.name: price-does-not-replace-tokens
transforms.effect: priceUsageUpdates may add costUsd and does not replace totalTokens. It runs before reduce.

transforms.name: reduce-copy
transforms.effect: The reducer copies totalTokens onto the usage observation.

transforms.name: sum-canonical
transforms.effect: totalContribution prefers totalTokens. Canonical contributions fold into cumulativeTokens, including a real zero.

transforms.name: row-total
transforms.effect: derive agentTokens copies cumulativeTokens to tokens.total. No builtin view reads it.
